items.title: Evident Vascular receives US FDA clearance for high-fidelity AI-powered IVUS imaging platform
items.summary: Evident Vascular has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k) clearance of the Evident Vascular guidance system and Evident peripheral imaging catheters.

items.title: Sex-specific analysis of SYMPHONY-PE finds comparable outcomes following aspiration thrombectomy
items.summary: Imperative Care has announced new findings from a pre-specified sex-specific analysis of the SYMPHONY-PE investigational device exemption (IDE) trial, which evaluated the Symphony thrombectomy system in patients with intermediate-risk pulmonary embolism (PE).

items.title: Inquis Medical launches SENSE-PE all-comer postmarket registry of Aventus thrombectomy system
items.summary: Inquis Medical has announced the launch of SENSE-PE, an all-comer postmarket registry evaluating the safety and efficacy of the Aventus thrombectomy system in patients treated for acute pulmonary embolism (PE).

items.title: Randomised trial finds cyanoacrylate glue comparable to standard of care
items.summary: Addressing a “gap” in evidence concerning long-term follow-up and unique complications associated with VenaSeal (Medtronic) cyanoacrylate glue, Kathleen Gibson (Bellevue, USA) presented podium-first randomised data which demonstrated that the device is comparable to standard of care, defined as surgical vein…

items.title: What does an in-stent reocclusion really cost—clinically and financially?
items.summary: Cook Medical’s peripheral arterial disease (PAD) symposium at the 2026 Charing Cross (CX) Symposium (21–23 April, London, UK) included a presentation from Koen Deloose (AZ Sint-Blasius Hospital, Dendermonde, Belgium), who shared learnings from the REALDES study on the true cost of intervention.

items.title: Why do Cook Medical’s DES and Boston Scientific’s DES produce such different restenotic morphology?
items.summary: Cook Medical’s peripheral arterial disease (PAD) symposium at the 2026 Charing Cross (CX) Symposium (21–23 April, London, UK) included a presentation from Charles Bailey (Emory School of Medicine, Atlanta, USA), who unpacked the data behind the differences between the two drug-eluting stents (DES) and what this means…

items.title: Surmodics launches MetalPro direct-to-metal hydrophilic coatings for medical devices
items.summary: Surmodics has announced—at the opening of Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT) 2026 (31 October–3 November, San Diego, USA)—the launch of its MetalPro direct-to metal ultraviolet (UV) cure hydrophilic coatings engineered to bond directly to metal surfaces without primers or tie-layers.

items.title: Rampart extends total-body radiation protection to interventional imagers with Vanguard launch
items.summary: Rampart has announced the launch of Rampart Vanguard—a new radiation protection solution that has been purpose-built for interventional imagers working at the head of the table.

items.title: Vygon obtains CE marking for Stiletto next-generation extended-dwell peripheral catheter
items.summary: Vygon has obtained CE marking for Stiletto, its next-generation extended-dwell peripheral catheters equipped with SlipStream technology, the company announced in a press release this week.

items.title: Radiation safety in endovascular procedures—what are we still overlooking?
items.summary: As the topic of radiation safety across various interventional specialties continues to garner increased interest, Melissa Kirkwood (Dallas, USA) homes in on the under-recognised issue of clinician hand exposure during these procedures. For neurointerventionists, fluoroscopy is essential to guiding complex procedures.

items.title: The ‘paclitaxel evidence lifecycle’ and the case for faster, more innovative evaluation of PAD interventions
items.summary: Weighing in on the fallout from the recent European Society for Vascular Surgery (ESVS) focused update on paclitaxel devices, Matt Popplewell (Leicester, UK), Thanos Saratzis (Leicester, UK) and Matthew Menard (Boston, USA) advocate a move towards newer research methodologies that aim to shorten the timeline between…

items.title: UK government confirms indefinite recognition of CE-marked medical devices
items.summary: The UK government has confirmed that it will continue to accept CE-marked medical devices on a long-term basis, meaning devices and in vitro diagnostic devices (IVDs) already approved for the EU market will remain available to patients across the UK.

items.title: From fistula-first to fighting fibrin sheath—VASBI delegates discuss re-emergence of catheters in vascular access
items.summary: Delegates at this year’s Vascular Access Society of Britain and Ireland (VASBI) annual scientific meeting (24–25 September, Liverpool, UK) discussed and shared new data on one of the most contentious issues in dialysis access: the field’s increasing shift away from previous ‘fistula-first’ attitudes in favour of more…

items.title: Multinational trial of low-cost drug targets primary inflammation in PAD patients
items.summary: As the global burden of peripheral arterial disease (PAD) continues to rise, so too does the need for strategies to reduce an “unacceptably high” vascular risk in patients with the condition.

items.title: New pathway and guidance aim to improve NHS services for patients with varicose veins
items.summary: GIRFT has published a pathway and guidance for NHS varicose vein services.

items.title: Penumbra receives US FDA clearance for Lightning CAVT technology for the treatment of DVT
items.summary: Penumbra has announced that the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted clearance for the treatment of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) to its Lightning computer-assisted vacuum thrombectomy (CAVT) technology. The indication is supported by results from the BOLT-DVT investigational device exemption (IDE) trial.

items.title: Haemonetics announces US FDA approval of PerQseal Elite vascular closure system
items.summary: Haemonetics has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of the PerQseal Elite vascular closure system for large-bore arterial procedures.

items.title: US FDA approves Gore Viabahn VBX balloon-expandable endoprosthesis for expanded use in FEVAR and BEVAR
items.summary: Gore today announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of an expanded indication for the company’s Viabahn VBX balloon-expandable endoprosthesis (VBX stent graft) for use in fenestrated and branched endovascular aneurysm repair (FEVAR and BEVAR).

items.title: Endovascular Engineering receives two US FDA 510(k) clearances for PE thrombectomy devices
items.summary: Endovascular Engineering (E2) recently announced that the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted 510(k) clearance for both the Hēlo thrombectomy system and Hēlo Return, a blood return system.

items.title: Gustavo Oderich named executive director and future chairman of VEITHsymposium
items.summary: Frank Veith (Case Western Reserve University, Cleveland, USA; New York University Medical Center, New York, USA), chairman of the VEITHsymposium, has announced that Gustavo Oderich (Baylor College of Medicine, Houston, USA) will be assuming the role of the organisation’s executive director with a commitment to become…

items.title: STRIKE-PE interim analysis indicates “potential for reduced burden of post-PE syndrome after treatment with CAVT”
items.summary: Investigators presented a new interim analysis of 1,000 prospective patients from the STRIKE-PE trial, looking at one-year functional outcomes and quality of life for pulmonary embolism (PE) patients after computer-assisted vacuum thrombectomy (CAVT), demonstrating that functional status and capacity were sustained…

items.title: Laguna thrombectomy system meets primary endpoints in pivotal pulmonary embolism study
items.summary: Innova Vascular has announced positive results from the pivotal TRUST study, which evaluated the Laguna thrombectomy system for the treatment of pulmonary embolism (PE). The data were presented at the Vascular InterVentional Advances (VIVA) conference (4–7 October, Las Vegas, USA).
